learning.title: Help & learning
learning.welcomeBody: Get to know JanusX in four small actions: choose a project, open a terminal, try split panes, and view a file. No model setup needed. Leave whenever you like.
learning.centerBody: Learn by working in your workspace. Continue where you left off, or start again whenever you need a refresher.
learning.finishBody: Verified and skipped steps are recorded separately. Continue working, or try again to practice the steps you skipped.
learning.duration: 4 steps · About 3 minutes · No model needed
learning.returnHint: Use Help & learning in settings to continue or replay at any time.
learning.savedHint: Leaving keeps your progress. Continue from Help & learning.
learning.projectMissing: There is no active project. Return to project selection to continue. Your recorded progress is kept.
learning.cliHint: Shell needs no model. External CLIs such as Claude and Codex need their own installation and login; Island uses a separate model configuration.
learning.actionError: The action failed. Check the folder or terminal configuration and retry, or skip this step.

workspace.title: Choose a project
workspace.body: Choose a local project folder. Your files stay where they are. If a project is already open, use the current workspace.
workspace.waiting: Waiting for a project. Canceling folder selection does not advance the guide.

terminal.title: Open your first terminal
terminal.summary: Start Shell or a configured CLI in your project.
terminal.body: Choose Open Shell, or use a terminal entry in the workspace. New terminals start in the project folder (or current worktree) shown below. You can reuse an existing live terminal.
terminal.waiting: Waiting for a terminal to start successfully. Failed launches do not count.

split.title: Work in two terminal panes
split.summary: Drag a tab to a content edge and release to split.
split.body: Prepare two terminals. Drag one terminal tab to the left, right, top, or bottom edge of the content area, then release when the drop hint appears. Reuse existing terminals when possible.
split.waiting: Waiting for two live terminals in separate panes. You can skip this step if dragging is difficult.

files.title: View a project file alongside your work
files.summary: Open the file tool on the right and select a file.
files.body: Open the file tool on the right and double-click a text, code, or image file. View it in its own window, then return here to continue. No editing or saving is needed. You can skip this for an empty folder.
files.waiting: Waiting for a file in the current project to open successfully. Opening the file tool alone does not count.

workspace.label: Workspaces
workspace.activitySummary: {{total}} terminals · {{running}} running · {{needsApproval}} awaiting approval · {{needsInput}} awaiting reply · {{degraded}} limited · {{errors}} errors
workspace.railHint: Click to switch workspace · → to view terminals

delete.title: Delete workspace
delete.confirm: Delete workspace {{name}}? This does not delete files on disk, but removes all terminal sessions and checkpoint records under this workspace.
delete.checkpointWarning: Terminal snapshots and checkpoint data will be cleared

browser.title: JanusX Browser
browser.startHint: Open a local app, preview a page or read documentation. Start with a URL.

titlebar.closeConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to quit JanusX? Unsaved changes may be lost.

emptyWorkspace.title: Get started with JanusX
emptyWorkspace.hint: Pick a local folder as your workspace, switch anytime

toolGroup.toolsNeedSpace: Not enough space. Widen the window or collapse the right workspace.

mobileRemote.lanTestHint: LAN test build: connect the phone and computer to the same local network. Public signaling and STUN are unavailable. Mobile UI and long-term stability are still under development.
mobileRemote.pairingHint: Scan with your phone, then approve the connection here.
mobileRemote.title: Mobile remote
mobileRemote.qrRefreshHint: Refreshes automatically without interrupting authorized connections or running terminals.
mobileRemote.signalRequired: Enter a public wss:// signaling URL reachable by both devices
mobileRemote.lanHint: For the same LAN or mutually reachable virtual networks. Cellular phones cannot reach ordinary private LAN addresses. Check the interface and computer firewall if connecting fails.
mobileRemote.publicHint: A default signaling service is provided. Generate a QR code or enter your own service URL. Both devices must reach it; terminal data travels directly over UDP. Some networks may still prevent connection.

automations.chooseTemplateHint: Choose a template, then fill in the task and schedule.
automations.replaceTemplateHint: Replaces this task's content and schedule, keeping its name.
automations.intervalTemplateHint: Send a notification every few minutes. No project or model needed.
automations.dailyReminderTemplateHint: Notify you at a chosen time each day.
automations.reviewTemplateHint: Read new commits, review code and save a report.
automations.reminderPermission: Sends scheduled notifications without a project or model. Requires the app to remain running; missed reminders are not replayed individually.
automations.title: Automations
automations.openIslandHint: Expand Island alongside the automation panel
automations.localOnly: Runs on this computer while the app is open. Scheduling stops when the app exits.
automations.empty: Create a card to group tasks, then add reminders or code reviews. Each task has its own schedule.
automations.name: Task name
automations.baselineHint: Full commit SHA; empty keeps baseline, new tasks start at HEAD
automations.permission: Read-only report. Saving authorizes reading commits and sending them to the selected model. Trial runs call a model; they do not modify the project or publish reports externally.
automations.noRuns: No runs yet. Start one with Run now.
automations.instructionsHint: Describe what to review and the expected output…
automations.gitHint: Read new commits and changed files since the last review.
automations.artifactHint: Collect review results into a traceable report.
automations.deleteDescription: Deletes this card and all its tasks, schedules, run history and related notifications. Project files and exported files are kept. This cannot be undone.
automations.deleteActive: Affected running or queued tasks will be stopped.
automations.deleteConflict: This item changed. Review the refreshed version before deleting it.
automations.cancelEdit: Cancel editing and return to card
automations.sharedModelHint: Internal Agent steps within this task share this model.
automations.emptyCard: No tasks yet. Add a reminder or code review.
automations.createCardForTask: Create a card for this task
